title: Tous les classements 2026 — Grand Raid de La Réunion
claims: The 2026 Diagonale des Fous results list 2,126 finishers and 640 DNFs.
The 2026 results list the race as 180 km with 10,200 m of positive gain, starting Thursday 15 October at 22:00 in Saint-Pierre.
Hugo Deck is listed as the 2026 men's winner in 22:54:19.
R. Croft is listed as the 2026 women's winner in 27:13:22.
The results platform is the official Grand Raid timing and results service linked from the organiser's site.
